what: the six ConvLines networks of the registered studies (d = 7-13: study 2, d = 15: study 3, d = 17: study 4; d = 17 in its deployed form only)
load: convlines.decoder.load_network(name): ConvLines(d, grid, **arch) + load_state_dict(safetensors); a network with "tables" instead of "file" (d = 17): convlines.decoder.load_tables(name), the deploy tables for timing/engine.py

d7_b1w64_r740.format: safetensors, fp32 state dict of convlines.net.ConvLines (including the buffer A)

policy.rule: route a shot to correlated PyMatching iff |c| < tau (float32 c compared in double precision), else flip = (c > 0)
policy.fit: tau routes the fraction q of 200,000 calibration shots (the least confident), fitted before any test shot existed; q chosen by a registered rule from the grid 0-16 %

training.weights: exponential moving average (0.999) at the last step

d7_b1w64_r740.deployed_executable: timing/d7 (a hand-written persistent CUDA kernel for sm_90a with the weights resident in shared memory, and its compiled router; built by timing/d7/build.sh)

provenance.note: the safetensors file holds the checkpoint's state dict unchanged
